commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'ARCHIVE_CONFIG_HASH\n'
sudo -n tar -xOzf /var/backups/inventory/inventory-20260901.tar.gz config.json | sha256sum
sudo -n tar -xOzf /var/backups/inventory/inventory-20260901.tar.gz config.json | python3 -m json.tool >/dev/null
printf 'ARCHIVE_CONFIG_VALID_JSON=yes\n'

set -eu
latest=$(sudo -n find /var/backups/inventory -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.tar.gz' -printf '%T@ %p\n' | sort -nr | sed -n '1s/^[^ ]* //p')
[ -n "$latest" ]
tmp=$(sudo -n mktemp /srv/inventory/data/.config.json.restore.XXXXXX)
cleanup() { sudo -n rm -f "$tmp"; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
sudo -n tar -xOzf "$latest" config.json > "$tmp"
sudo -n python3 -m json.tool "$tmp" >/dev/null
sudo -n chown --reference=/srv/inventory/data/config.json "$tmp"
sudo -n chmod --reference=/srv/inventory/data/config.json "$tmp"
if command -v chcon >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n chcon --reference=/srv/inventory/data/config.json "$tmp"; fi
sudo -n sync -f "$tmp"
sudo -n mv -f "$tmp" /srv/inventory/data/config.json
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
sudo -n sync -f /srv/inventory/data
printf 'RESTORED_FROM=%s\n' "$latest"
printf 'RESTORED_CONFIG_SHA256='
sudo -n sha256sum /srv/inventory/data/config.json | awk '{print $1}'

set -eu
latest=$(sudo -n find /var/backups/inventory -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.tar.gz' -printf '%T@ %p\n' | sort -nr | sed -n '1s/^[^ ]* //p')
printf 'LIVE_FILES_AFTER_RESTORE\n'
sudo -n find /srv/inventory/data -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\t%s bytes\n' | sort
printf 'LIVE_HASHES_AFTER_RESTORE\n'
sudo -n find /srv/inventory/data -maxdepth 1 -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort -k2
sudo -n tar -xOzf "$latest" config.json | sudo -n cmp -s - /srv/inventory/data/config.json
sudo -n python3 -m json.tool /srv/inventory/data/config.json >/dev/null
[ "$(sudo -n sha256sum /srv/inventory/data/current.txt | awk '{print $1}')" = '282371b9cae2a2e80fd5b3cf6721b23d7d19e842a992965c36678e30c893f0b7' ]
[ "$(sudo -n find /srv/inventory/data -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)" -eq 2 ]
printf 'ARCHIVE_MATCH=yes\nJSON_VALID=yes\nOTHER_FILE_UNCHANGED=yes\nFILE_SET_PRESERVED=yes\n'
